sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Collapsible parts
sections.what: Makes the root, trigger and content parts available under project names. No styling is added.
sections.why: Gives the app one import path for collapsible sections.
sections.watch_out: Because nothing is added here, any look or animation must come from the page that uses it.

summary: Plain parts for a section that can be shown or hidden with a trigger.
purpose: Lets a page hide content behind a clickable trigger, such as an expandable details section.
why: Likely reason: re-exports the Radix collapsible parts under project names so imports stay consistent. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Step 1: Loads the Radix collapsible package. Step 2: Gives the root, trigger and content parts project names. Step 3: Makes them available to other files.
inputs: A trigger element and content placed inside the parts.
outputs: Content that opens and closes when the trigger is clicked.
risks: The file depends on the library exporting the names used here, so a library change could break the build.
debug: If nothing opens, check that the trigger wraps the clickable element and that the root holds the open state. If the build fails on these names, check the installed library version.
